<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/components/nav.ts -->
<!--
  The buttons at the end of a top bar: login, the call to action and the theme button (it only reports the
  press). No wrapper: they sit in the row of the bar.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type NavActionsProps = {
    login?: string;
    loginHref?: string;
    cta?: string;
    ctaHref?: string;
    actions?: "none" | "cta";
    tone?: "default" | "inverse";
    themeLabel?: string;
    ontheme?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";

  let {
    login,
    loginHref = "#/login",
    cta,
    ctaHref,
    actions = "cta",
    tone = "default",
    themeLabel,
    ontheme,
  }: NavActionsProps = $props();
</script>

{#if login}
  <Button
    variant="ghost"
    size="sm"
    href={loginHref}
    class={(((tone as string) === "inverse") ? "text-background hover:bg-background/10" : "")}
    data-testid="nav-login"
  >
    {login}
  </Button>
{/if}
{#if (((actions as string) === "cta") && cta)}
  <Button
    variant={(((tone as string) === "inverse") ? "secondary" : "default")}
    size="sm"
    href={ctaHref}
    data-testid="header-cta"
  >
    {cta}
  </Button>
{/if}
{#if themeLabel}
  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" data-testid="theme-toggle" onclick={() => ontheme?.()}>
    {themeLabel}
  </Button>
{/if}
